question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH visit_purchases AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE page_id = 13 AND event_type = 3
),
visit_product_views AS (
    SELECT 
        e.visit_id,
        p.product_id,
        COUNT(*) as page_view_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE p.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13) AND e.event_type = 1
    GROUP BY e.visit_id, p.product_id
),
visit_product_adds AS (
    SELECT 
        e.visit_id,
        p.product_id,
        COUNT(*) as add_to_cart_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE p.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13) AND e.event_type = 2
    GROUP BY e.visit_id, p.product_id
),
visit_product_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        vpv.visit_id,
        vpv.product_id,
        vpv.page_view_count,
        COALESCE(vpa.add_to_cart_count, 0) as add_to_cart_count,
        CASE WHEN vp.visit_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as was_purchased
    FROM visit_product_views vpv
    LEFT JOIN visit_product_adds vpa ON vpv.visit_id = vpa.visit_id AND vpv.product_id = vpa.product_id
    LEFT JOIN visit_purchases vp ON vpv.visit_id = vp.visit_id
)
SELECT 
    CAST(product_id AS INTEGER) as product_id,
    CAST(SUM(page_view_count) AS INTEGER) as times_viewed,
    CAST(SUM(add_to_cart_count) AS INTEGER) as times_added_to_cart,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN was_purchased = 0 THEN add_to_cart_count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as times_left_in_cart,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN was_purchased = 1 THEN add_to_cart_count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as times_purchased
FROM visit_product_stats
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id
